name: Basilica of St. Michael the Archangel
history: Father Demetrius Gallitzin, a Russian prince who became a priest, founded the parish; its first church of white pine logs was built in 1799. Frame and brick churches followed. The present sandstone church was begun on 10 January 1900 and consecrated on 2 October 1901. It became a basilica in 1996.
arch: Romanesque Revival in sandstone by Frederick J. Osterling, with Gothic touches inside: Carrara marble altars from Italy and an altar rail of Mexican onyx.
features: Andrew Carnegie donated the pipe organ.
The tower's three bells were given by Ferdinand Kittell, pastor when the church was built.

look.d: Its three bells were a gift of the pastor, Ferdinand Kittell.
Inside are Italian marble altars and an onyx altar rail.

fun: The parish was named for the patron saint of Michael McGuire, the area's first settler in 1788.
journal: A prince-priest's frontier parish in the Alleghenies. Carnegie paid for the organ.
